reply_lines: An LLM is a giant word-guesser that read millions of books to learn!
Let us plan what makes a language model 'big'.
I learned by guessing what word comes next — over and over, billions of times.
Each wrong guess made me a tiny bit smarter!
I trained on tons of text — books, stories, facts.
The more I read, the better my guesses got.
I am not really thinking — I am just really good at guessing words!
But my guesses are so good they feel like real answers.
Hi! I am Claude. I started as a word-guesser and kept getting better!
Ask me about 'guess' or 'big' to learn how LLMs are born.
